section.before: Communications graduate (B.A., Westbrook University) with one marketing internship and two years running the social channels of a student society. Helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought in about 300 visitors, and grew a newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers. Raised average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event through a weekly reel series. Looking for a first full-time marketing role where audience-facing campaigns and clear reporting matter.

content: Communications graduate (B.A., Westbrook University) with one marketing internship and two years running the social channels of a student society. Helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought in about 300 visitors, and grew a newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers by adding a sign-up QR code at the till. Raised average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event through a weekly reel series on Instagram and TikTok. Looking for a first full-time marketing role where audience-facing campaigns, event support and clear reporting matter.
